subject: Less cleanup, more diagramming: what's new in Mermaid this March
snippet: Highlight sync, smarter AI, and a tighter experience across every tool you use.‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌
body_plain:
Product Newsletter | March 2026

There's a version of diagramming where *everything just clicks.*


The node you click takes you to the line you need. The color you defined once applies everywhere it should. The AI gets it right on the first pass. This month's updates are about closing the gap between the diagram in your head and the one on your screen.


**✨ Flowchart highlight sync: V**isual and syntax, always in step****


When you're deep in a complex flowchart, losing your place between the visual and the syntax is a small tax that adds up fast. 


**Highlight sync** keeps the two in step. Select a node – the corresponding code highlights. Edit the code – the node lights up. Hit "go to code" and you're there. It's two-way, it's instant, and once you've used it you won't want to go back.


[ Try synced editing](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ72ijH5VumQJqW2vlRPilTxI/8khUqE_xU9iy)


**🎨******Custom styles: define once, apply everywhere****


Style drift is easy to miss until you're ten nodes in and nothing matches. 


**Custom styles** let you define a visual style once and reuse it across the entire diagram. This month: cleaner results when combining styles, hex color support for precise control, and less syntax to get there. The diagrams you were building manually now just work.


[ Try it in the editor](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7AVnJImGrtzcGCiuEIq1BZQ/yC05QkOGxNjB)


**🧠 **More accurate AI, private by default****


Better accuracy means less cleanup (and privacy you can count on). The **models powering Mermaid AI **got meaningfully better this month: more accurate output, fewer syntax errors on the first pass, faster responses. We also made improvements to how we handle your data – so you can diagram confidently knowing your content stays private. 


The kind of update that makes everything feel tighter without you having to do anything differently.


[ Create with Mermaid AI ](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7IIrLW2cxNfO0MW31BxGtBY/8IlYAzs36GRT)


******🐚 ****Today's seashells **

Small things that make a real difference.


- 

[**VS Code**](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Q5vNjIz2rL9kWJBo54Wang/vhkqqzE7tjhs) **plugin (v2.5.9)**: Sign in works everywhere now (OAuth and manual token login both supported). Repair broken diagrams with Mermaid AI directly in the editor, with AI credits visible in the preview. Plus, visual diff for Regenerate and Remote Sync so you can see what changed before it does.


- 

[**Word**](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7XszPwZL8L0vUg6KayBmIPo/qIUsuEBskNnt)**, [**PowerPoint**](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7fg3S9phDoghEptTNrJ201w/_sE24g1TwUDN), & [**Google Docs**](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7nT7UN63JIMSyzgcAkQHhe4/Ql1qmfLYPpkx) plugins:** Cleaner login, redesigned diagram cards, updated action buttons. Less noise, better feel.


- **OSS has a [**new home**](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7vGBWaMPOm2Ej9TkxdXXPGC/DLpHhlsvRHVF):** The open-source library now lives at mermaid.ai – same library, better docs, faster path from bug report to fix.


**📌 What to try this week**


1. Open a complex flowchart and click a node. See where it takes you. 
2. Apply a custom style to a diagram you've been creating by hand. 
3. Re-run a prompt you've used before through Mermaid AI. The improvement is most noticeable on diagrams you already know.
Happy diagramming, 

*The Mermaid Team*

 

[Contact Us](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/28xHLtxYQ50fUzqnjVbczNLqd0b9mbOH2e/eQBg0Dv9I_uJ) | [Documentation](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/28xHLtxYQ51BfaVwV2oFVqUR3ut1MYEMTg/JHmrac3GGrNz) | [Unsubscribe](https://f1gxg.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/un/v2/sh/WCPxRrWByckTigZW4C7tc2nB79zIZqDQ/1tvFFMnMjoi1)

snippet: Dear Investor, With reference to BSE notices 20210922-64 dated September 22, 2021 and 20211022-44 dated October 22, 2021, Stock Brokers are required to upload segregation and monitoring of collateral
body_plain:
Dear Investor,
		
		
		
			 
		
		
			With reference to BSE notices 20210922-64 dated September 22, 2021 and 20211022-44 dated October 22, 2021, Stock Brokers are required to upload segregation and monitoring of collateral at client level on daily basis.
		
		
			 
		
		
			
			Your Stockbroker KOTAK SECURITIES LTD. has reported the details of Funds balance and Securities balance as on 14/03/2026 to Clearing Corporations, is attached.
			
		
		
			Please follow the procedure given below for opening the attachment:
		
		
			         1. Click on the attachment provided with this email.
			         2. You will be prompted for your password.
			         3. The password is your PAN in upper case
		
		
			 
		
		
			
			Please note that negative number in the file represents debit balance/balance payable by you. Also, the funds and securities balances provided are what is maintained with your broker and does not include balance in your personal bank account and demat account.
			
		
		
			Yours faithfully,
		
		
			 
		
		
		
			BSE Limited
		
		
			 
		
		
			In case you find any discrepancy, we advise you to take up the matter immediately with your member. You may contact your stock broker at KSCUSTOMER.COMMUNICATIONS@KOTAK.COM or 18002099191.                             
		
		
			 
		
		
			Investor may follow the BSE Social Media Handles for Investor education: 
		
		
			 
		
		
			
				LinkedIn:          https://www.linkedin.com/company/bseindia
				Twitter:           https://twitter.com/BSEIndia
				YouTube:         https://www.youtube.com/user/BSEworld
				Facebook:        http://www.facebook.com/bseindia
				Instagram:       http://instagram.com/bseindia

			
		
		
			
			Do's & Dont's

			1. Deal only with registered intermediaries - check the registration certificate of the intermediary you are dealing with. It allows recourse to regulatory action.

			2. Beware of fixed/guaranteed returns schemes. Brokers or any of their representatives are not authorized to offer fixed/guaranteed returns on your investment or enter into any loan agreement to pay interest on the funds/securities offered by you.

			3. Do not fall prey to emails and SMSs luring you to trade in stock/ securities promising huge profits.

			4. Ensure to fill all the required details in KYC document by yourself and receive duly signed copy of your KYC documents from your broker. Check for all conditions that have been agreed and accepted by you.

			5. Opt for electronic (e-mail) contract notes/financial statements only if you are computer savvy and have an e-mail account of your own. Don't ignore any e-mails/SMSs received with regards to trades done by you. Verify the details of the same and report discrepancy, if any, to your broker in writing immediately

			6. Trade verification facility is also available on BSE website.

			7. Check the frequency of accounts settlement opted for and verify your monthly/quarterly settlement statements. Any discrepancies observed therein should be brought to the notice of your broker in writing immediately.                  
			
		
		
			                                                                 
		
		
		
		
			For Awareness of Investors –
		
		
			 
		
		
			निवेशकों की जागरूकता के लिए –
		
		
			 
		
		
			You are requested to take note of the Exchange’s norms with respect to claims against trading members who have been declared as defaulters. The said norms are available on Exchange website under Investor section. The link of the same is given below:
		
		
			 
		
		
			आपसे अनुरोध है कि ट्रेडिंग मेंबर जिन्हें डिफॉल्टर घोषित किया गया है उनके खिलाफ दावे के संबंध में आप एक्सचेंज के मानदंडों का ध्यान रखें |उक्त मानदंड एक्सचेंज कि वेबसाइट पर उपलब्ध हैं | उसी का लिंक नीचे दिया गया है: 
		
		
			 
		
		
			Norms with respect to claims against Trading members who disabled / suspended /declared defaulter prior to September 4, 2022: 
		
		
			 
		
		
			4 सितंबर, 2022 से पहले अक्षम / निलंबित / डिफॉल्टर घोषित किये गए ट्रेडिंग मेंबर के खिलाफ दावों के संबंध में मानदंड: 
		
		
			 
		
		
			https://www.bseindia.com/downloads1/Normseligibilityclaimsdefaultermember.pdf
		
		
			 
		
		
			Amended Norms with respect to claims against Trading members who disabled / suspended /declared defaulter post  September 4, 2022: 
		
		
			 
		
		
			4 सितंबर, 2022 के बाद अक्षम/निलंबित/ डिफॉल्टर घोषित किये गए ट्रेडिंग मेंबर के खिलाफ दावों के संबंध में संशोधित मानदंड: 
		
		
			 
		
		
			https://www.bseindia.com/markets/MarketInfo/DispNewNoticesCirculars.aspx?page=20220819-32
		
		
			 
		
		
			The list of trading members who have been declared as defaulters is available at the following link:
		
		
			 
		
		
			जिन ट्रेडिंग मेंबर को डिफॉल्टर घोषित किया गया है, उनकी सूची निम्न लिंक पर उपलब्ध है |
		
		
			 
		
		
			https://www.bseindia.com/static/members/List_defaulters_Expelled_members.aspx
		
		
			 
		
		
			PS: In case of any doubt/query in Hindi translation please rely on English version.
		
		
			 
		
		
			टीप: अगर आपको हिंदी अनुवाद में कोई संदेह है तो कृपया अंग्रेजी संस्करण का संदर्भ लें।
		
		
			 
		
		
			
			The data is being provided to the clients on an “as is” and “where-is” basis, without any warranty. The Exchange shall not be  liable for any delay or any other interruption which may occur in providing the data due to any reason including network (Internet) reasons or snags in the system, break down of the system or any other equipment, server breakdown, maintenance shutdown, breakdown of communication services or inability of the Exchange to send the data. In no event shall the Exchange be liable for any damages, including without limitation direct or indirect, special, incidental, or consequential damages, losses or expenses arising in connection with the data provided by the Exchange through this facility.

			You are requested to note that in the event of trading member being declared as defaulter, all transactions executed on the exchange trading platform within 90 calendar days prior to the effective date of disablement of the trading member or after the latest monthly/quarterly settlement date, if any, in respect of the claimant whichever is later shall be considered eligible for compensation from IPF subject to Rules, Byelaws, Regulations, guidelines etc. of the Exchange and SEBI circulars and subject to the norms laid down by the relevant Committee.

			Now keep abreast with the happenings of the stock market on your Android Phone. BSEIndia's New Mobile App now provides many more features & also supports 9 Indian languages namely Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Oriya, Tamil, & Telugu. 

			Link for Android google playstore 

			https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cazaayan.bse.mobile&hl=en

			Link for Apple iPhone  

			https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/bseindia-on-mobile/id808101185?ls=1&mt=8

			Features

			What's New ?

			•    Voice based Search
			•    Improved Layout and Navigation
			•    Customizable Home Page
			•    Introduction of Tabs
			•    Facility to Re-order Tabs
			•    Creation of Portfolio
			•    Additional Information in Get Quote like Results, Corporate Actions etc.
			•    Graph for Stock prices & Index Values with pre-defined & selectable periods, with zoom in & zoom out facility
			•    Index Overview and Index Contribution
			•    BSE CMIE Indices
			•    Sensex Heat map - All 30 securities at one go.
			•    ETFs Data
			•    Results Calendar, Board Meetings, Notices
			•    IPOs/OFS/ New Listings                  
			
		
		
			                                                                 
		
		
			  Thanks, Regards 
		
		
			 BSE                             
		
		
			                                             
		
		
			
			This is a system generated email, do not reply to this email id.

subject: Kombucha Honey is our first Microlot of 2026!
body_html:
And it's a love affair between coffee & tea!
 ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏ ͏­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­ 

A love affair between coffee and tea!

Tea and coffee have long been seen as opposites — like fire and water. But the Kombucha Honey flips that idea on its head! Hand-pulped beans were submerged in kombucha and fermented for 96 hours, unlocking a buffet of flavours.

KOMBUCHA HONEY

Our 2026 harvest season had many firsts.

We worked closely with our smallholder producer partners to set up a PICO unit – a tiny, village-level processing hub where people came together to sort fruit, supervise fermentation and drying, and even turn waste into black gold — compost. The Microlots of 2026are the result of this collective effort — careful processing, shared learning, and many hands at work.

KOMBUCHA HONEY

These Microlots are more than coffee.

Beyond taste, the Microlot Programme is a vital part of our mission to strengthen smallholder livelihoods. Through this programme, producers can earn over 1.4x the market price, helping them break cycles of debt.

KOMBUCHA HONEY

Frogmouth is back!

It's been a year. We missed this one.

Frogmouth is our ode to the grumpy and super-camouflaged Sri Lanka Frogmouth. This washed Arabica comes from our partner farmer-producer organisation, Aadhimalai, in the Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu. The farmers belong to the Irula and Kurumba communities, and intercrop coffee with fruits and spices!

right resources to create high quality and up-to-date benchmarks. To

body_plain:
Studioheads, assemble!    
    
There’s a new song drop and it’s absolutely jaw-dropping.
    
Free-flowing and groovy “Holi Aayi Re” by Vishal Mishra, Malini Awasthi and Prateeksha Srivastava featuring Shinji Kulkarni, offers a multi-hued treat.
    
Weaving together the splendour of Braj region, the charm of Vrindavan and the rustic vibe of Awadh, the song is sure to leave you awe-struck.  Besides, the infusion of Jogira, the hip-hop style folk melody from the Purvanchal region only elevates the conversational rhythm of the music.
    
Fusing authentic Indian instruments of ghadwa and deru with deep electronic synths, guitars and more, “Holi Aaye Re” offers a harmonious symphony of cultural magic and modern beats.

  उल्लास और उमंग से भरा हमारा यह पर्व फसलों की कटाई के मौसम का प्रतीक है। इसमें समृद्धि और कृतज्ञता के साथ-साथ नवजीवन की भावना भी भरी है। हमारे सिख भाई-बहनों के लिए यह त्योहार बहुत विशेष है। यह अवसर हमारे लिए ऐतिहासिक भी है, क्योंकि इसी दिन श्री गुरु गोबिंद सिंह जी ने खालसा पंथ की स्थापना की थी। पूज्य सिख गुरुओं द्वारा दिखाया गया यह मार्ग हम सभी को एक बेहतर समाज के निर्माण के लिए प्रेरित करता है।  
     
  बैसाखी हमारी परंपरा और विरासत से लोगों के गहरे जुड़ाव का भी स्मरण कराती है। यह हमारे किसान भाई-बहनों की कड़ी मेहनत का भी उत्सव है। उनका समर्पण भाव हमारे राष्ट्र का पोषण करता है और करोड़ों लोगों के लिए खाद्य सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करता है। यह त्योहार संगीत, नृत्य और साझा विरासत के जरिए भी लोगों को आपस में जोड़ता है।  
     
  मेरी कामना है कि नई फसल का यह मौसम हर किसी के जीवन में सुख, सफलता और उत्तम स्वास्थ्य लेकर आए।  
     
  आपका,
